typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	startTime as string ()
}

source(output(
		MCID as string,
		EDL_LOAD_DTM as string,
		EDL_RUN_ID as string,
		EDL_SCRTY_LVL_CD as string,
		EDL_LOB_CD as string,
		EDL_EXTRNL_LOAD_CD as string,
		EDL_SOR_CD as string,
		INCRD_YEAR_MNTH_NBR as string,
		RPT_MDL_NM as string,
		CLNCL_CNDTN_CD as string,
		SRC_CRTRIA_LVL_CD as string,
		LOB_PARTN_ID as string,
		DSPLY_OPT_CD as string,
		MDL_CI3_KEY as string,
		SUBSCRIBER_ID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource derive(MCID = MCID) ~> PlaceHolderRowCount
PlaceHolderRowCount derive(File_Name_Output = right($ImportFile, locate('\\', reverse($ImportFile), 1) - 1),
		File_Load_Datetime = $startTime) ~> DeriveFileNameColumm
DeriveFileNameColumm sink(input(
		EDL_RUN_ID as string,
		SRC_CRTRIA_LVL_CD as string,
		FILE_LOAD_DTM as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		FILE_NAME as string,
		SUBSCRIBER_ID as string,
		DSPLY_OPT_CD as string,
		EDL_SCRTY_LVL_CD as string,
		RPT_MDL_NM as string,
		INCRD_YEAR_MNTH_NBR as integer,
		MCID as integer,
		LOB_PARTN_ID as integer,
		EDL_LOAD_DTM as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		EDL_LOB_CD as string,
		EDL_SOR_CD as string,
		MDL_CI3_KEY as string,
		EDL_EXTRNL_LOAD_CD as string,
		CLNCL_CNDTN_CD as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		EDL_RUN_ID,
		SRC_CRTRIA_LVL_CD,
		FILE_LOAD_DTM = File_Load_Datetime,
		FILE_NAME = File_Name_Output,
		SUBSCRIBER_ID,
		DSPLY_OPT_CD,
		EDL_SCRTY_LVL_CD,
		RPT_MDL_NM,
		INCRD_YEAR_MNTH_NBR,
		MCID,
		LOB_PARTN_ID,
		EDL_LOAD_DTM,
		EDL_LOB_CD,
		EDL_SOR_CD,
		MDL_CI3_KEY,
		EDL_EXTRNL_LOAD_CD,
		CLNCL_CNDTN_CD)) ~> OLEDBDestination
